description: Submits an RFQ to the SCiMon.co RFQ Desk and returns an RFQ number plus one upload link per listed file. A SCiMon sourcing expert follows up by email at contact_email. Export-controlled (ITAR, EAR, CUI) work is not accepted here.

export_controlled.description: True if any part or data is ITAR, EAR or CUI controlled. Must be false to submit here.

nda_required.description: True if the buyer's own NDA must be signed before files are shared.

need_by.description: Date parts are needed at the ship-to location, YYYY-MM-DD.

description.description: What the part is and what it does.

files.description: File names for this part, e.g. ["bracket_B.step", "bracket_B.pdf"]. For PCBA: Gerbers, BOM and pick-and-place.

finish.description: Finish or coating, e.g. black anodize.

process.description: Preferred process if known: CNC machining, sheet metal, die casting, injection molding, PCBA, cable assembly, aluminum extrusion, custom rubber, 3D printing, subassembly, box build, design services, or not sure.

preferred_regions.description: Asia, Mexico, USA or no preference.

stage.description: design, prototype, pilot, production or box build

name: submit_rfq
title: Submit an RFQ
